question.prompt:
Assuming \(a
eq3,\) \(b
eq4,\) and \(c
eq5,\) what is the value in simplest form of the following expression? \[ rac{a-3}{5-c} \cdot  rac{b-4}{3-a} \cdot  rac{c-5}{4-b}\]

solutions.title: Match factors and signs
solutions.explanation:
Each denominator contains the same subtraction as a numerator, but in reverse order. Reversing a subtraction changes its sign, which lets us cancel factors without expanding.

In particular,
\[
5-c=-(c-5),\qquad
3-a=-(a-3),\qquad
4-b=-(b-4).
\]
Combining the fractions and matching these factors gives
\[
\frac{(a-3)(b-4)(c-5)}{(5-c)(3-a)(4-b)}
=
\frac{(a-3)(b-4)(c-5)}{(-1)^3(a-3)(b-4)(c-5)}.
\]
The conditions \(a\ne3\), \(b\ne4\), and \(c\ne5\) ensure that every canceled factor is nonzero. The expression therefore equals \(1/(-1)^3=\boxed{-1}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
